notes.content:

Thank you.

notes.title: Regular update notes for Aguest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/0904c8e2e8a617de27d4e9cb31218b72b47a1d3f.png[/img]

Hi Guys!

How was your summer in 2024?

Let's start the 37th developer note.


-


[b][h3]updated the Extra Chapter.[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/6d82949a5cc7443a6869be9c68cbdaf78a9692a6.png[/img]

If you complete the Lv.5 event after achieving the Lv.5 reliability of all client, you can enter the Extra Chapter.
Extra chapters are bonus episode. That extra chapter consists of seven days of stages.
You can check out the true ending of the Polar Penguin Post after the Snow Festival in the Extra Chapter.

Players who have already met the conditions for entering the extra stage can start the extra stage by loading the saved data with credit.
You can also replay the story in the Extra Chapter through the 'Story Replay' Ui.


-


The Polar Penguin Post will see prices rise after its next update, September update.
The increase price is 17,000 won and the official launch price will be 18,000.

I will try to be a Polar Penguin Post and LittleLemonBulb who give you a more enjoyable gaming experience.

Thank you.


LittleLemonBulb

notes.title: Regular update notes for July
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/325ec47886ea6ed1c82a390ceb626145cffa8963.png[/img]

Hello!

At the end of July, when the rain stops and sunlight begins to fall in earnest.
LittleLemonBulb is also continuing its development in the heat.

Let's start the 36th developer note.


-


[h3][b]1. Modify shield item system for temperature[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/04c1eafc5e2ccfc24aa93302f3ac24b05cda9a3c.png[/img]

    We changed the properties of the two temperature items that operated as 'Fix item temperature at a specific stage' as follows.
    
    - Cold insulation: Fix 'Cold' temperature → Lower the temperature of the wrapped item by one level
    - Lagging : Fix 'Warm' temperature → higher the temperature of the wrapped item by one level
    

[b][h3]2. Delete shield item 'Cork block'[/h3][/b]
    
    The 'Cork Block' item sold by the Store has been deleted.
    

[b][h3]3. Add 6 new shield items[/h3][/b]
    
    We have added six new shield items with higher functions of existing shield items.
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/cdd53fa5a91fddb7745e737e3b9d41f8bb282faa.png[/img]

    - Three shield items have been added to cover two kinds of Damage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/de7a8529062eed1353452ddbb11128cc41d0ad77.png[/img]

    - Three shield items have been added that fix the temperature of the item at the specified stage.


[b][h3]4.Added tutorial about 'temperature'[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/294a04529ae5b4391db4edf5758624046f83d17e.png[/img]

    - Added 3 'temperature' tutorials on day 27.
    - You can check more detailed and clear temperature system guidance than previous tutorials.


[b][h3]5. Store - Shield Item UI Error Correction[/h3][/b]
    
    Fixed an issue where some of the scrollbar contents on the purchase page of shield items were cut.
    

-


The heat is continuing to worry about heat stroke.
Take care of your health everyone and LittleLemonBulb will be back with the next patch notes.

Thank you.

From LittleLemonBulb

notes.title: Regular update notes for June
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/2ab5da66f8eb21a4de1c21b47633d694abddefa3.png[/img]


[h3][b]1. When some deliveries of the same attribute are side by side, change so that all of those deliveries are damaged.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/6fd66f2a3aa07b32c65708d7f44d2229b7e58acc.png[/img]

From this update, if deliveries made of glass or ceramic are close to each other without shield items, they will suffer from mutual damage and be damaged.


2. Add secondary breakage
    
We have added the 'secondary damage' attribute to some of the deliveries.
In the case of deliveries in containers that may be damaged, such as glass bottles, damage will cause flooding and pollution damage.
    
The extent of damage to the secondary breakage is the same as the primary breakage.


3. Change the contents of the order
    
We have made some changes to the contents of the order form after the 24th day.

    
4. Change some of the day missions
    
We have made some changes to the day mission form after the 24th day.

    
5.  Bug Fix
    
Fixed a bug where the Water Bottle(s) shipment was not recognized.
    

-

The Polar Penguin Post is participating in the summer sale, which runs until July 11.
During this sale, you can buy Polar Penguin Post with a 10% discount.

Thank you.

Little Lemon Bulb

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the Water Bottle(s) shipment was not recognized.

notes.title: Regular update notes for May
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/abccc818753218b3a9ec890996bac26c9eb5cb3e.png[/img]


[b][h3]1. Add system 'Flooding'[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/522ee35dd639a47e03f7bdc8f4a26fdcfa98e6a0.png[/img]

We added new system 'flooding damage'. 
It means that if the weather is 'snow', the bag gets wet and the delivery is damaged.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/297f8864034f589adf13b77dbb13b33242c2b30b.png[/img]

A 'waterproof bag' was added for the flooding countermeasure.
    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/786d7f32aef1056682288099546dc642478ec967.png[/img]

The weather can be checked by the weather mark at the top of the center.
And In snowy weather, the delivery list and penguins were expressed to be wet.
    

[b][h3]2. ‘A Non-Rotatable’ [/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/08ceaba86a7727b51c091c4f81a4ff3bfbca3949.png[/img]    

Certain deliveries have become 'non-rotational'.
    
The 'non-rotatable' deliveries cannot use an existing rotary key.
If a 'non-rotatable' deliveries appears as a delivery, the bag arrangement should be carried out considering the part that cannot be rotated.    


[b][h3]3. Add system 'categorize delivery'[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/3b013aa72bfc786839bd3f4f0ab5d075764f7e49.png[/img]    

We have added a 'categorize delivery' system that delivers as many as the number of compartments requiring 'secondary category' of deliveries.
In the delivery list, 'categorize delivery' appears mixed with regular delivery.
    

[b][h3]4. Modification of in-game[/h3][/b]

- We have changed the number of 'minimum delivery quantities' required for each date.
- We have changed the weather for some dates.
- We have changed the play time limit for some dates.
- If the weather is 'cold', the delivery list has been changed to freeze.
- In the results window, the broken and missing icons were removed after AS progress.
- Delivery orders after the 17th have been greatly added and revised.


[b][h3]5. Bug fix[/h3][/b]

- We have modified the 'port base' so that it does not disappear from the results window.


-


Thank you.
From Littlelemonbulb

We have added a 'categorize delivery' system that delivers as many as the number of compartments requiring 'secondary category' of deliveries.

notes.title: Regular update notes for April
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/1a7d76b87317c90a5cb67a96f5686610d33cdda0.png[/img]

Hi Guys!

It is May, Family Month. It has become warmer and sunny day after day.
Are you having a great May?

We start the 33rd developer note.



-



[h3][b]Normal ending update[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/0eb57f7e15f2608f5ee0884d09bfb19c125d6150.png[/img]

Added 'normal ending' for day 50 of Polar Penguin Post.

The normal ending consists of the Polar Penguin post default ending and a reliability ending for each customer.

The confidence ending will appear after the normal ending if you have lifted the customer's confidence level 5 and read the level 5 event.



[b][h3]Add Epilogue[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/0eb57f7e15f2608f5ee0884d09bfb19c125d6150.png[/img]

Added an epilogue event with a normal ending.
Epilogue events have different numbers of events depending on how many clients have achieved level 5.

The epilogue event consists of a total of three events.


[b][h3]Adding Reliability Events[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/10d1f054fbb658b43ebfd03e5a24c0eba5480a62.png[/img]

Added a 4,5 level reliability event from MiCo Company.
Added a reliability event at the port base.
All added events can be found in 'Review the Story'.


[b][h3]Corrections[/h3][/b]

- The number of days required to open a confidence event has been partially adjusted.
- Some of Mikko Company's 2nd to 3rd step reliability event scripts have been modified.
- An ad has been added to the 'radio' in Chapter 12.
- The appearance area and event type of some day missions have changed.
- The name of the item 'Gomstramus said this' has been changed to 'Gomstramus Quotes'.


-


We’re happy to be able to come back as the first ending of the game.
We'll do my best until the end.

Thank you.


LittleLemonBulb

notes.title: Regular update notes for January
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/60dd81c32ec77fcb1f441830b1da2426085bc95c.png[/img]

Hello,
It's been half the winter. We heard this winter's cold is bad. How are you doing?

Let's start with the 31st developer note.


-


[h3][b]1. Chapter 10, 11 Update[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/015e029329ec3177e88ecdcb5a4697054c5bce4b.png[/img]

In this build we added chapters 10 and 11.

Chapter 10 is for 4 days from day 37 to day 40, and Chapter 11 is for 3 days from day 41 to day 43. A total of 7 days of stories have been added.

The story of the Polar Penguin Post is also nearing its end. We look forward to working with you until the end.

This update story is uploaded without translation. We are going to add translation later.
Also, the game story can be partially modified according to the development process.



[b][h3]2. New Area 'Port Base' Added[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/fd13ad8ea31f3ca8e673a6add24b94157a613352.png[/img]

Following the new chapter update, the 'Port Base' icon has been added to the 'Map'.

The port base will appear from Chapter 11 (41 days).

From Chapter 11, you can send deliveries to the 'port base'. You can also pick up the port base day mission on the map.



[h3][b]3. Add temperature indication to item icon[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/c2658c7ed233f259241a5e12e10a541cf8b81e37.png[/img]

Added a chip shape mark at the top left of the item icon.

We have made the corresponding UI for clear indication of 'what temperature should you deliver' some delivery temperature sensitive items.

The UI is built-in without going through research stores.



-

In the second week of February, there is a Korean holiday ‘Seol-nal’

Accordingly, we will hold a sale to celebrate Seol-nal. Seol-nal sale will run for a week based on midnight on the 9th of Korean time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/9d76f0d2e74da5b233e39305ff17d3a7e47728bf.png[/img]

We also distribute wallpapers for desktop in commemoration of Seol-nal.
This Wallpaper is an illustration of NPC 'Gari', which is in charge of the radio of Polar Penguin Post, along with this year's symbol 'Dragon'.

"Gari" is a reward perk character provided by the sponsor of "CEO" Reward, the top sponsorship reward of Polar Penguin Post crowdfunding.
Once again, We would like to thank you for allowing me to be with a wonderful character.


▼▼ Download Link ▼▼
[url=https://www.artstation.com/artwork/QX3y2x][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/3884e978ac2c82dc717d175c4207e7314bcf04a6.png[/img][/url]
▲▲ Download Link ▲▲

In addition, Polar Penguin Post will participate in the "Indie Game Special Zone" of "Illusta Fest," which will be held at KINTEX in Ilsan on the third week of February.

At Illusta Fes, we will be conducting game demonstrations and goods sales. Please check the information that will be uploaded in the third week of February.

Thank you.

LittleLemonBulb

notes.title: Regular update notes for December
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/30578f6eab1a0606a759ad8ff68b7ac476404146.png[/img]

Hi Guys!
The last day of the year has come. Did you have a satisfactory year?

Polar Penguin Post 30th Developer Note begins.


-


[h3][b]1. The story of the "Polar Penguin Post" has been drastically revamped.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/6799b78ce45a5d87435c8b1d4e1ed75f9b9772ed.png[/img]    

The story has been drastically revised to make it easier for you to read the various things that the 'Polar Penguin Post' goes through.
    
 More stories have been added about Winter Mountain and its main character brother and sister. We'd appreciate it if you enjoyed it.
    

[b][h3]2. Add Story Illustrations[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/0cf3e59c3a51464582e48740afcf755b099d2d38.png[/img]    

 We have added illustrations to some stories. You will be able to understand the various situations unfolding in the story more easily through the illustration.

    

[b][h3]3. New Character 'Piphi'.[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/4cd778b5a4614e691260275556d2d69419f8c59a.png[/img]
    
Along with the reorganization of the story, a new character 'Piphi' appears.
piphi is the mother of Min and Hour. She is a teacher at Winter Mountain School.  
    
 In the future, I think we will tell more stories of Min, Hour and Winter Mountain through her.
    

[b][h3]4. Fixing a bug where the story replay menu in Chapter 5 only outputs Day18[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/3ccc7177194748d7843035a3f6e594408d49968d.png[/img]
    
 We fixed the bug that only appeared on Day 18 when you chick the Chapter 5 replay in the 'Replay Story' menu, which you can enter from the 'Polar Penguin Post' button on the main menu and 'Map', 
    

-

    
 What was 23 years like for you?
    
 I hope you will be able to leave the past times when you were sad and happy with ease and welcome a bright new year.
    
 Thank you.
 LittleLemonBulb.

tags.feature: The story of the "Polar Penguin Post" has been drastically revamped.
Add Story Illustrations
New Character 'Piphi'.

notes.title: Regular update notes for November
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/01058282a3a9061a4df19de86302c2464fb41afa.png[/img]

Hi Guys!
It's December when the weather gets colder and the streets are covered with illuminations.

Polar Penguin Post 29th Developer Note begins.


-


[b][h3]1. Inventory UI Reorganization
    [/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/e8374dfddde54b4848ac644058fd72d73bed891f.png[/img]
  
The 'Inventory' that you can check in the lobby has been reorganized.
    
The delivery list has been moved to the right end so that it feels the same as the existing "in-game."
In addition, we have changed the marking icon to make it easier to check the character of each item.
    

[h3][b]2. Hour's note update[/b][/h3]
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/e8374dfddde54b4848ac644058fd72d73bed891f.png[/img]
   
Hour's Note, a system that allows you to check information on items [by paying Hour for overtime] within the Inventory UI, has been added.
    
Hour's notes provide information on what items to be careful about when dealing with each item and what items are damaged and what items are damaged.
(The system is still being tested. Inundation-related scripts have not been updated, so there is no information on whether they are harmed/damaged)

    
[b][h3]3. Modify item classification[/h3][/b]
Classification of some items has been added or modified. These changes can be found in the 'Inventory' to be updated.
    

[b][h3]4. Replacing English Scripts for Chapter 0.[/h3][/b]
  The English script for chapter 0 has been replaced by a formal translation. The translation may be slightly revised before release.
    

[b][h3]5. Later schedule[/h3][/b]
    
There will be a big story revamp in next month's update. Scripts that were out of context will change and new NPCs will emerge.
    
New illustrations will also be added.
    
Details of this will be found in the update notes at the end of December.

    
    -
    
It's a fun end of the year.
LittleLemonBulb will also work hard to show you great updates at the end of the year.
    
Thank you.
    
From LittleLemonBulb

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/b4c70f2dd194da804b3a3d8e050490531273df41.png[/img]

Hi Guys!
trick-or-treat!! Today is Halloween!

Polar Penguin Post 28th Developer Note begins.


-


[b][h3]Added <Chapter 8>’s Outro(Day32 End)[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/bc1d1b83ad3396a26aaa922c1e60cd76e0e69a8b.png[/img]

How will the king and queen react to Min's suggestion about the future of the Winter Mountain?
This event is also available through 'Review the Story'.


[b][h3]Added New Chapter <Chapter 9. Each person's circumstances>[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/4010d15fa3adb34d73c4cb70c3cab7a300669e4d.png[/img]

Chapter 9 consists of four stages from Day 33 to Day 36.
In Chapter 9, NPC Looksa appears in earnest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/b1c663eb9e9aef44d209557f01ea757bb3355d3a.png[/img]

Luxa is the chief determiner of the Winter Mountain Defence Force. She's also Kirsch's boss.
Luxa is also a generation that went through an incident that happened in Winter Mountain a long time ago.
How will General Luxa's appearance change the Polar Penguin Post?

The Japanese/English version of Chapter 9 is beta.
We're going to replace it with the official version later.

-

I hope you have a great Halloween.
The Polar Penguin Post will come back next month with a more advanced appearance.

Thank you.

LittleLemonBulb

notes.title: December Regular Update Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42358424/c93888f32afdb54bbd0bc1b1b6958688ca571c8c.png[/img]

Developer notes before Early Access can be read here.[url=]https://tumblbug.com/polarpenguinpost/community/creator[/url]

Hello, we're Little Lemon Bolb!
t's the end of 2022. Let's start the last developer note of the 2022 year of the Polar Penguin Post.


1. A regional order filter will be added to the right side of the order.
    It was difficult to find the necessary order form in the mixed order form. To improve this, we have added a regional order filter.
    
2. Changed how inventory displays property ranges and sizes.
    We merged the attribute compartment, which was divided into 3 pages of harm damage / causing damage/ delivery size, into 1 compartment.
    
3. Added letter ascending/descending filters at the top of the inventory.
    The Filter button at the top of the inventory lets you sort your shipments up and down by name.
    
4. If there is any damage to the item, the bag will pause and the name of the Item that is missing the hour.
    In order to help the player recognize the damage to the shipment more easily, we have slowed down the bag in the event of damage.
    And Hour pointed out the name of one of the missing/damaged items and emphasized the damaged/missed delivery once more.
    
5. If a temperature bag and a temperature packing material are used, the range of use is fixed to the temperature of the packaging material or bag.    
    The temperature system will continue to balance.
    
6. Day 1 of the lobby screen will be added with the Day 1 arrow.

7. When the minimum quantity on Day 1 is achieved, an 'early leaving work' arrow appears.

8. Other amendments report
    - Damage properties have been added to cotton, pickles, vinegar, and rye bread.
    - The 'high temperature damage' of kerosene and ethanol items has disappeared.
    - The 'high temperature damage' of kerosene and ethanol items has disappeared.
    - Corrected damage error of lamb and gas tank.
    - Corrected the error of perfect stamping when water and food are missing packaging.
    - The error that caused the inventory scroll bar to be distorted when you went to this game by continuing has been corrected.
    - Minor changes have been made to the wheel scroll feel.
    - The 'Rip' breakage range of the scissors has been changed to be limited to the edge of the blade only.
    - I modified the packaging material text to make it easier to understand.
    - Corrected the error of Day1's metabolism output.
    - Fixed an error where some detailed classifications were not displayed in the lobby inventory.


We will come back to you with the January Developer Note in the new year of 23.

We hope you have a great year. Thank you as always.
- From LittleLemonBulb

notes.title: Patch Note Ver.20221207
notes.content:
1. Fixed a problem that allows you to purchase convenience functions indefinitely at the store.

2. Fixed a problem that the purchase button was pressed even when there were 0 Item to be purchased at the store.

3. Modified the receipt UI to disappear in the event of a purchase failure.

4. Changed the color of Auto-save slot so that you can distinguish it more clearly from the regular save slot.

5. The 'GA-RI' studio phrase on the radio has been changed to 'GA-RY'.

6. Modified the request for the non-delivery quest that appeared on the 6th day and changed it to allow normal delivery.

7. Fixed an error where the 'Dr. AA' line of the Chapter 2 ending event was printed as 'Min' line.

8. Fixed an error that prevented the store from purchasing skills when restarting the date.

9. Changed the positions of 'Continue' and 'Start'.

10. Changed it so that the 'Continue' button does not appear if there is no auto-saved data.

11. Fixed a bug where the game ended when you pressed Start without save data.

12. The radio's text replay is all aligned to the left.

13. Fixes the error of replaying the 'Ending Credit' when the 'New' button is pressed after play until the end.

14. Fixed an error that failed to open the demo version's clear data in the early access version.

15. Item 'Scissors' breakage range has been modified.

16. Fixed a breakage error in item 'vodka'.

17. corrected the error of being able to move the item placed in the bag while it was paused.

18. Added 'Empty Bag' button.

19. Modified it so that the placed item does not reset when the bag is changed.
(If you change to a bag with the same character and a different compartment shape, the item will be reset.
General Bag -> Divider Bag = Reset. General Bag -> Insulation Bag = Not Reset)

20. Corruption property of 'Egg' item has been modified.

21. Corruption property of 'Firewood' item has been modified.


We have fixed the problem of auto-save disappearance, but there are still few cases of discovery, so it is hard to say that it is a perfect fix. 
We put a warning massage in the current play version. If you find a bug that auto-save disappears after this notice(20221207), please write down your findings in the "Discussion".

I'm sorry for the inconvenience in your play.


-
